latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI Online Course Empire 1.0.0

- Automates the entire online course creation workflow: from market research to full curriculum and sales assets.
- Scrapes Udemy, Skillshare, Reddit, and Google Trends to validate high-demand, low-competition course topics.
- Reverse-engineers top-selling course structures and generates a complete course curriculum with module scripts.
- Produces sales page copy, a launch email sequence, and a course promo video using Apify, InVideo AI, and Claude AI.
- Designed for anyone with expertise who wants to launch a profitable online course in under 48 hours.
